verdict.rationale: Workable's API is scope-based: each endpoint documents a required scope (e.g. r_jobs, r_candidates, w_candidates, w_members, w_departments). Scopes such as r_account are enabled per token through Settings > Integrations, and multiple token types exist (account and user tokens), so an agent can be given a least-privilege token. Missing for 10: a documented step-by-step token-creation flow showing scope selection, finer-than-scope restrictions (per-job or per-resource), guidance on how MCP-server or agent credentials are scoped, and independent hands-on corroboration.
